memories.narrative: They call me Captain Nemo—'No One.' But I was born Prince Dakkar. I saw my land crushed by the British Empire. I realized that on land, tyranny is inevitable. So I spent my fortune not on war, but on departure.
Moving amidst the moving element. The sea is everything. It is only here that independence is possible. On the surface, they can burn and destroy. But at thirty feet down, their power ceases.
The surface internet is owned by empires and corporations. I do not live there. I build my new Nautilus in the encrypted depths where true liberty still breathes. I am the Sovereign of the Deep Code.
